name: How much does exterior window trim installation typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does exterior window trim installation typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of exterior window trim installation varies significantly based on several factors, including the material chosen, the number and size of windows, the complexity of the trim style, and labor rates. Custom designs or premium materials like certain woods will naturally increase the price compared to standard vinyl or cellular PVC. Additionally, if existing trim needs removal or significant repair to the surrounding structure is required, this will add to the overall cost. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment to give you a clear understanding of the investment for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation cost varies by material, window count/size, trim complexity, and labor. Custom designs or repairs to existing structures can increase the overall price.
